description: Bitcoin and Ethereum trend signal: the long-only state for each sleeve (LONG or CASH), the 50-day trend gate each trades on, and the BTC 200-day master gate that overrides both, evaluated on UTC daily closes with price and day change. A rules-based risk-on/risk-off verdict for crypto, not raw price data. Free; exactly one completed UTC close behind, evaluated every calendar day including weekends and stamped with the close used (signal_close_date).
name: get_crypto_trend
